model: one-compartment, first-order absorption and elimination, F = 1

formulas.body_mg: sum_i D_i * KA/(KA-KE) * (exp(-KE*t_i) - exp(-KA*t_i)), t_i = hours since dose i (t_i >= 0)

smoking.model: ke(t) = KE*M(t); r = cigarettes in the last 24 h; M* = 1 + EMAX*r/(EC50+r); dM/dt = KDEG*(M* - M); r0 = average cigarettes/day over the first START_AVG_DAYS after the first logged cigarette (span at least 1 day); before that cigarette M = M*(r0), and the part of the 24-h window before it counts r0 per day; after now M stays at M(now); snus is not counted

check_values.scenario: 20 cigarettes/day at 7:00 + j*15/19 h (j = 0..19) on days 0-13, then none; t in hours from day 0 0:00; caffeine 150 mg at 13d 8:00, 13d 14:00, 15d 8:00, 15d 14:00
